_doc: Flame colours of the Wayfarer's lantern (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 item 837): cosmetic endgame rewards, nothing else changes. The colour tints the light circle in caves from Era III on (soft edge); Era I and II keep their ink look. unlock: {} (always), {flag}, {record, at} (GameState.records value at least at) or {hall_clears} (BattleHalls.total_clears). Scripts: LanternColors.gd, PauseMenu Storm Lantern, EraLightLayer.
